capabilities: Explore the vault as an interactive 3D graph with search, selection and note opening
Fly a starfighter through notes in a flight-and-combat sandbox
Share a multiplayer room with up to four pilots over a relay
Replay the vault's creation history as a timelapse animation
Fold folders or tags into single points and reopen them
disambiguation: Not a game app or publishing tool; Pilot mode is a sandbox that never selects, opens or changes a note, and the plugin never writes to the vault.
extras: Formerly named Constellation Graph with the same plugin id. Desktop only, requires WebGL and Obsidian 1.7.2 or newer. Multiplayer has not yet been tested across the internet between real installs, and the free default relay has usage limits.
problem: Obsidian's graph view is a static 2D layout, with no 3D navigation, animation, or shared multi-user viewing of the vault.

summary: Interactive 3D galaxy view of the vault's notes and links, with a starfighter flight sandbox and up to four-pilot multiplayer.
